command:
set -e
ls -la /app
printf '\nLog files:\n'
find /app/logs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -printf '%f\n' | sort
printf '\nSample contents:\n'
for f in $(find /app/logs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' | sort | head -n 5); do
  echo "--- $f ---"
  head -n 10 "$f"
done
